primary_comparison: all (27 original + 8 engineered) versus raw for each of three families
production_comparison: no_log (27 original + 7 engineered) versus raw for each family
selection: Highest mean outer AP among raw and no_log across three families; lower mean Brier then key breaks exact ties. The eight-feature arm is a research comparator; excluded from deployment to remove redundant log-income attribution.
ablation: Four logistic without_BLOCK modes remove the named block from no_log; originals retained. Age added to logistic no_log as sensitivity analysis only.
tuning: Original eight-point grid per family, inner five-fold AP; all learned transformations inside pipeline.
calibration: After training-only tuning, cross_val_predict chosen pipeline on five training folds; fit sigmoid to OOF scores. Hyperparameter selection and sigmoid fitting share outer-training data, never outer-test data.
threshold: Maximize F1 on calibrated outer-training OOF scores over 0.05..0.80 step0.005; larger wins ties. Final fit repeats this on all development data. No outer labels used in a fold threshold.
inference: Paired Nadeau-Bengio corrected t intervals: SE=sqrt((1/25+294/1176)*sample_variance), df24. Two-sided p-values; Holm over three AP family comparisons within each feature specification. Approximate dependent-CV inference, not independent replication.
interpretability: Every outer held-out row: K80 and top-three Jaccard for logistic and forest in raw/all/no_log; 50 stratified training bootstrap refits per outer fold, parameters fixed. TreeSHAP explains uncalibrated base forest probability; linear explains calibrated log-odds. Group calibrated-probability explanations remain separate.
interpretability_intervals: Paired bootstrap of five repeat-level averages (10000 resamples); descriptive conditional repeat variability, not population-level CIs. Row observations across repeats are not independent.
ranking_crosscheck: Spearman of held-out mean absolute attribution ranks versus five-shuffle AP permutation importance on the same transformed source attributes; recombine one-hot levels. Engineered-column permutation is a representation-level diagnostic and may create inconsistent combinations.
example_policy: Reuse prior illustrative employee 478; first repeat held-out fitted models; chosen previously for high risk, not representative.
limitations: Exploratory upgrade on previously examined fictional data. Winner chosen across outer-CV results, so selected-winner score may be optimistic; no new independent or temporal test. No human comprehension study performed.
